csv_project_name: A/E for Statewide CCC Faclities Preservation
csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR) is soliciting Statements of Qualifications from qualified Architectural/Engineering (A/E) firms to provide professional design and construction administration services for the renovation and restoration of historic structures located at sites within ODNR properties throughout the State. During the Great Depression, Civilian Conservation Corps (CCC) labor profoundly shaped landscapes across these parks damming streams to form lakes, planting tree seedlings to restore native forests, and constructing recreational facilities that continue to serve the public. This project seeks to honor and preserve that legacy by restoring a series of CCC-built structures, ranging in scale from small trailside shelters to large picnic pavilions containing multiple stone fireplaces. The following list includes locations for planned CCC improvements and is subject to change due to funding and prioritization. 1. Tar Hollow State Park 2. Hocking Hills State Park 3. Scioto State Forest 4. Mohican State Park and Mohican State Forest 5. Jefferson State Park 6. Lake Loramie State Park 7. Indian Lake State Park 8. Pike Lake State Park 9. Lake White State Park
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering
